posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Maybe none of us have said this, but PATCHs are created by anonymous people who, as far as I remember, have never come here to promote their systems. Goliath, as already mentioned, is not based on version 1.12a, so it is not covered by the EULA, at least I read it a few times and that's what I understood, it would make no sense to release a EULA for a version that is not the Publisher's own rights.
If you don't want to dedicate yourself to the programming part because it really is something complex, just do what you said, migrate to another edition, like RMVXAce, and be able to install RGSS3 scripts without difficulty, buy or request new scripts with your own specifications, but I really recommend MV or MZ in this case because they have experienced volunteers who are more active in the official community and on the servers outside.
Good luck

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Considering that each glyph is 12x12 I had an idea that might work and you can continue using this Goliath.
Change the last glyph to a simple white square that corresponds to
$z
. There is nothing in the example just to understand the logic:
In the Systemset you have several unused colors:
Copy the first "Color" to the unused colors, in the case of the example I will use all of them starting from 5:
So using the transparency color, just draw each glyph within the 16x16 limit, but instead of centering it, try drawing from the second pixel from left to right:
In the text boxes you just need to use the command
\c[id]
to call any of these from 5 to 19
Code:
Hello player, press the \c[6]$z\c[0] key to open the menu
I haven't been able to test if it works yet, because I'm not at home.
You will probably need some adjustments, the ideal would be to draw each one separately or use an image editor with layer support to move each one of them, I assume you won't need more than 14 new glyphs, but if you need to, just copy the same systemset and change it in the game to use another list, but only in dialogues and not in the menus.

Click to expand...
Goliath is not for 1.10+ as mentioned.
However Maniacs is, as far as I'm aware, compliant with the Patch EULA, and there is no reason not to upload a game using Maniacs patch, that's why it's widely popular now.
By the way, another idea for you could be modifying the font files themselves (using the tool "Fony") to include more glyphs in the upper ASCII characters area that you are probably not otherwise using, replacing characters like "ü". To make glyphs wider than a single character, just split them in parts and use multiple characters in a row. Then replace the default fonts in ultimate_rt_eb.dll with your modified versions using Resource Hacker. I believe how this is done was already explained in your other thread.
